scientific.integrity: The motivating arXiv preprint and publisher full text were inspected at the harvested model, equilibrium Jacobian, Theorem 6.1, Example 1, Conjecture 4, Figures 7–8, and the concluding high-harvest discussion; publisher pages containing the harvested equations and figures were visually inspected. A primary nonlinear-harvesting comparator was inspected for broader coverage. The bundled checker replays source-example algebra and numerics; the theorem itself is analytic. Independent audit has not been performed.
scientific.limitations: The theorem classifies the high-harvest coexistence branch for r>m and the existence cutoff for r=m. It is not a global basin theorem, does not classify r<m, and does not exclude additional intermediate-q equilibria or boundary attractors.

title: A sharp high-harvest coexistence dichotomy in the fear-driven predator–prey model
